title: Windows Always On VPN — Device Tunnel Before User Logon (IKEv2, Machine-Certificate Auth) via Intune
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (Always On VPN device tunnel; IKEv2 machine-cert auth; ProfileXML via custom OMA-URI in SYSTEM/device context; VPN gateway head-end + PKI certificate lifecycle; higher risk/irreversible logon-path ops).
Includes the certificate-lifecycle section (proposed product #6) folded in rather than sold standalone.
VPN gateway (RRAS / Azure VPN Gateway) internals deferred to Microsoft docs.
